final_message:
I fixed the bug in `workdays.py`: the weekday check in `business_days_between` was `weekday() < 6`, which counts Saturday (weekday 5). I changed it to `weekday() < 5`, so only Monday to Friday count.

The two existing tests pass. I didn't add a regression test for the 2 March to 9 March 2026 case from the report, and I didn't run that case directly.
